sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme empowers tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project cost.
**Who is this for:** Individual, Self Help Groups (SHGS); Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Career information

**Detailed Description:** The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Under this scheme, tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project costs and the remaining 50% as a loan at a concessional interest rate.

**Benefits / Assistance:** > **Monetary Benefit** - 50% of the project cost or ₹5,00,000, whichever is less, provided as subsidy. - The remaining 50% of the project cost is provided as a loan. > ***Subsidy Disbursement*** - Given in two installments – 60% in the first installment and 40% in the second installment. > ***Interest Rate*** - Loan at 4% per annum. > ***Repayment*** - Loan (excluding subsidy) must be repaid in 20 equal installments over 5 years, including interest. - Option to repay earlier is allowed. > ***Beneficiary Contribution*** - No upfront contribution required from the beneficiary.

**Application Process:** ##### ***Registration Process*** - Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation [official website](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/home). - Click on the "[APPLY FOR LOAN](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/gtdcloan)".- Select the scheme name "Foreign Study". - Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password. - Click on the "Sign Up. - After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated. ##### ***Application Process*** - Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code. - After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed. - Click on the scheme you want to apply for. - Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents - Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Tribal Development Department
